claims.identified: Bulbapedia, Holofoil: "Mirage Holofoil was introduced with the Scarlet & Violet Series. It is visually similar to the Sheen Holofoil used during the XY Series, but refracts light horizontally rather than diagonally. Standard Holo cards also have Holofoil silver borders. The effect can be difficult to see clearly in photographs because its appearance depends on reflected light."
claims.limitation: The sources name an axis, not marks or geometry: the 2 bands, the contrast, and the reading that the field varies with x (bands vertical) are this build’s drawing, and which way the band TRAVELS is not claimed at all — the reveal clips rock the card and disagree on a sign. The silver foil border Bulbapedia documents on standard holos is NOT modelled — the mask is the illustration window — and the paper is identified at the SET level, because no printing record claims a Mirage card.
claims.border: documented in the source, deliberately not modelled
